text_markup: The Corp has {card:Targeted Marketing} in the play area when the Runner steals an agenda. In the next checkpoint, the game recognizes that the ability on {card:Targeted Marketing} that was preventing the operation from being trashed no longer applies, and so the Corp trashes {card:Targeted Marketing} as if it were completing its resolution.
